messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync: LargeCorp legal pushed back. They want any model swaps during their fiscal quarter to be "pre-approved" with a documented canary path. They asked us to pause 'automatic pin roll' for their accounts unless signed off.
Ravi (Eng): That sounds like a pin-exception request. We can gate automatic rollouts for specific tenants, but need a clear process so it doesn't become manual nightmare.
Lola (Product Ops): Proposal: add a 'pin-exception' workflow + form. Fields: tenant, model, allowed cutover window, fallback pin, acceptance metrics, runbook link. Triage weekly.
Tom (Sales): LargeCorp will only accept a one-time cutover per model and wants a 30-day grace overlap. They'll sign if we provide an explicit rollback SLA and credit terms.
Jin (Customer Success): From support: customers expect visibility in the console. Can we display a "Pinned for Cutover" badge and a link to the runbook?
Ravi (Eng): Console badge is trivial read-only. More complex: router-level enforcement and auto-fallback rules. Acceptance thresholds we need: p95 latency delta <= 20ms, error rate delta <= 0.2%, token cost delta <= 8%. If exceeded, automatic revert within 5m.
legal-bot: Reminder: Customer contracts require doc-upload for any pin-exception. Please attach runbook and sign-off form.
Maya (PM): Ok, canary path we discussed: provision in dedicated tenant pool, internal smoke tests, open to 1% traffic for 24h, 10% for 48h, then 100% cutover inside the approved window. Each stage requires CS + Eng signoff.
Lola (Product Ops): I'll create the pin-exception template and a triage rubric. Also suggest a temporary "onboarding throttle" mode for orgs with multiple model requests: onboarding_window_limit = 3 models/month.
Tom (Sales): Sales ask: can we offer a paid "pin-protection" add-on (contracted grace windows + SLA credits)? Would help close the deal.
Ravi (Eng): From infra: dedicate a pool label -> largecorp-cutover-<date>. Example commands: ```sh
ri admin create-pool --name largecorp-cutover-2026-06
ri admin pin-model --pool largecorp-cutover-2026-06 --model galactus-7b:2026-05-12
``` Also need router rule: on failure metrics: `route revert --to previous-pin --if error_rate>0.2% --duration 5m`.
Jin (Customer Success): I'll draft the comms to LargeCorp with the exact canary steps + SLA credit language for legal to review.
Maya (PM): Action items: Lola -> pin-exception template + triage rubric (48h). Ravi -> auto-revert router rule spec + alert thresholds (72h). Jin -> customer comms draft (24h). Tom -> pricing proposal for "pin-protection" addon (72h).
Lola (Product Ops): Noted. Will also log a temporary onboarding throttle config for product backlog.
Ravi (Eng): We should also record metrics for audit: cutover_id, auditor (CS/Eng), timestamps, pre/post perf samples. That satisfies legal and helps postmortems.
legal-bot: Attach contract clause sample: "Customer may request a model pin-exception during agreed window. Provider will execute cutover per signed runbook; Provider reserves right to revert per operational thresholds; credits apply if revert occurs due to Provider action."
Maya (PM): Thanks. We'll run a dry-run internally next week with two internal tenants to validate the workflow before offering to LargeCorp. Meeting to align on runbook Monday 10am.
Tom (Sales): I'll push the case to the customer and get written confirmation of their requested windows.
Jin (Customer Success): I'll prep the sign-off checklist so approvals are easy.
Maya (PM): Great job everyone. Keep updates here and upload artifacts to the shared board. :sparkles:
